scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,web "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w apps/web -- --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
